scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the explicitly inclusive integer-truncated PMF and CDF formulas, not the valid untruncated marginals.
A left-open truncation interval would change the modeled event and make the source denominator valid.
The numerical evaluation uses the source Brownian-range series; no inference is made about the authors’ implementation.
The related 2018 interior-deletion paper was accessible only through its public abstract and bibliographic record.
title: Inclusive truncation destroys normalization of the discrete Wiener-range law
